ignoreValues.reason: User confirmed: the 62x5px hero score bar animates width so the quarter-round corner (canon 5 structural signature) stays crisp; scaleX distorts it and there is no measurable perf gain at that size

Canon 5 makes the hero grid load-bearing, not decorative: it is one of the named structural signatures of the ambient hero, drawn at 3 percent alpha (--wa03) behind a radial mask so it reads as texture under the H1 and fades before the copy. Sumeet ratified keeping it, 2 Aug 2026. Scoped to the three .heroGrid declarations that draw it; the rule stays live everywhere else.

Sumeet ratified R-27.4. The rule targets a thick coloured border on one side of a CARD, which is a real tell. .pullQuote is not a card: it is a <figure> wrapping a <blockquote>, and a rule down the left edge of a quotation is the oldest convention in typesetting. The estate is already consistent about the distinction - .block in Editor.module.css carries a comment explicitly refusing a side tab on a card, and .prose blockquote uses the same left rule this does. Pre-existing since round 25b (f8dc9bf); the hook re-scanned the file because round 26 added the .embed rules to it. Scoped to this one file; the rule stays live everywhere else.
